description: Unique id: platform code, product code, market code.
Dataset edition. This file is 2026-Q4.
Short platform id: google_ads, meta, microsoft_ads, tiktok, x, linkedin, reddit.
Platform name.
forex_cfd (forex and CFD brokers), crypto_exchange (crypto exchanges and wallets), prop_firm (prop trading firms with paid challenges).
Market code: ISO 3166 alpha 2, or EEA_OTHER (EEA countries other than Germany) or ROW (platform default where no country rule applies).
Market name in plain words.
The strictest gate that applies. One of: allowed, restricted, no_specific_rule, licence_needed, verification_needed, written_permission_needed, not_allowed, unclear.
What an advertiser must do, in plain words.
Regulators the platform names for this market, if any.
Age or targeting limits the platform names, if any.
Title of the official policy page.
Link to the official policy page.
Short verbatim quote (25 words or fewer) from the official page that supports the status. "..." marks a cut.
yes = quote matched against the live page in a browser on 2026-10-07; manual_check = not yet matched.
Date the rule took effect, when the platform states it. Blank if not stated.
Date the page was checked.
Extra context, exceptions and our reading where the page is not explicit.
high = quoted from the official page for this market; medium = official global rule applied to this market; low = rule is ambiguous or the page could not be fully read.
Date of the policy change or notice.
day, or month when the source gives only a month (date set to the 1st).
Short platform id.
Platform name.
forex_cfd, crypto_exchange, prop_firm, or all_financial.
Market codes, comma separated, or global.
What changed, in plain words.
Where the change was published.
platform_notice (official) or press.
